text_en: I come to my garden, my sister, my bride; I gather my myrrh with my spice, I eat my honeycomb with my honey, I drink my wine with my milk. Eat, friends, drink, and be drunk with love.
text_cn: 我的妹妺，我的新娘！我进入了我的花园，采了我的没药和香草，吃了我的蜂巢和蜂蜜，喝了我的酒和奶。我的朋友！请你们吃，请你们喝；我亲爱的，请你们痛饮！

text_en: I slept, but my heart was awake. Listen! my beloved is knocking. “Open to me, my sister, my love, my dove, my perfect one; for my head is wet with dew, my locks with the drops of the night. ”
text_cn: 我身虽睡，我心却醒；听，我的爱人在敲门。 我的妹妹，我的爱卿，我的鸽子，我的完人，请给我开门！我的头上满了露水，我的发辫满了露珠。

text_en: I had put off my garment; how could I put it on again? I had bathed my feet; how could I soil them?
text_cn: 我已脱下长衣，怎能再穿！我已洗了脚，怎能再污？

text_en: My beloved thrust his hand into the opening, and my inmost being yearned for him.
text_cn: 我的爱人从门孔中伸进手来，我的五内大为感动。

text_en: I arose to open to my beloved, and my hands dripped with myrrh, my fingers with liquid myrrh, upon the handles of the bolt.
text_cn: 我起来给我的爱人开门，一摸门闩，我的手就滴下没药，手指滴下纯正的没药。

text_en: I opened to my beloved, but my beloved had turned and was gone. My soul failed me when he spoke. I sought him, but did not find him; I called him, but he gave no answer.
text_cn: 我给我的爱人开了门，我的爱人却转身走了；一见他走了，我好不伤心。我寻觅，却没有找着；我呼唤，他却不答应。

text_en: Making their rounds in the city the sentinels found me; they beat me, they wounded me, they took away my mantle, those sentinels of the walls.
text_cn: 巡行城市的守卫遇见了我，打伤了我；看守城墙的人，夺去了我身上的外衣。

text_en: I adjure you, O daughters of Jerusalem, if you find my beloved, tell him this: I am faint with love.
text_cn: 耶路撒冷女郎！你们若遇见了我的爱人，你们要告诉他什么？我恳求你们告诉他：“我因爱成疾。”

text_en: What is your beloved more than another beloved, O fairest among women? What is your beloved more than another beloved, that you thus adjure us?
text_cn: 你这女中极美丽的啊！你的爱人有什么胜过其他的爱人？你的爱人有什么胜过其他的爱人，致使你这样恳求我们？

text_en: My beloved is all radiant and ruddy, distinguished among ten thousand.
text_cn: 我的爱人，皎洁红润，超越万人。

text_en: His head is the finest gold; his locks are wavy, black as a raven.
text_cn: 他的头颅金碧辉煌，他的发辫有如棕枝，漆黑有如乌鸦。

text_en: His eyes are like doves beside springs of water, bathed in milk, fitly set.
text_cn: 他的眼睛，有如站在溪畔的鹁（bó）鸽的眼；他的牙齿在奶中洗过，按在牙床上。

text_en: His cheeks are like beds of spices, yielding fragrance. His lips are lilies, distilling liquid myrrh.
text_cn: 他的两颊有如香花畦（qí），又如芳草台；他的嘴唇有如百合花，滴流纯正的没药。

text_en: His arms are rounded gold, set with jewels. His body is ivory work, encrusted with sapphires.
text_cn: 他的手臂有如金管，镶有塔尔史士宝石； 他的躯干是一块象牙，镶有碧玉。

text_en: His legs are alabaster columns, set upon bases of gold. His appearance is like Lebanon, choice as the cedars.
text_cn: 他的两腿像一对大理石柱，置于纯金座上；他的容貌仿佛黎巴嫩，壮丽如同香柏树。

text_en: His speech is most sweet, and he is altogether desirable. This is my beloved and this is my friend, O daughters of Jerusalem.
text_cn: 他满面香甜，全然可爱。耶路撒冷女郎！这就是我的爱人，这就是我的良友。
